subject: Is it possible to access the name of the selected resource?

messages.author: 467aefc563ddfc2c
messages.subject: Is it possible to access the name of the selected resource?
parts:
Hi all, i tried to find the answer on this question online, but didn't find it.
Is it possible to access the name of a selected resource for a specific case.
I want to create an eventlog where i need this information.
Maybe there is a smarter way to do this, my current attempt is using the "log_" function (and eventually redirect the output to a file).

Example below based on sample code i found online:

advisors <- c("David", "Martin", "Tim")

wait_and_go <- 
  simmer::trajectory() %>%
  simmer::select(advisors) %>%
  simmer::seize_selected() %>%
  simmer::log_("...") %>%  # <- I want to log the name of the selected resource here
  simmer::timeout(1) %>%
  simmer::release_selected()

environment <-
  simmer() %>%
  add_generator("dummy", wait_and_go, function() 1) 

lapply(advisors, function(i) {environment %>% add_resource(i, 1)}) %>% invisible

environment %>% run(until=10, progress=print, steps=5)

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Is it possible to access the name of the selected resource?
parts:
Currently, it is not. In this example, you can reconstruct that event
log a posteriori using the output from
get_mon_arrivals(per_resource=TRUE), but I think there may be some
fair use cases there and it's something easy to implement, so I've
opened an issue to track this [1] and probably you'll get a new
get_selected() method in the next release. Thanks for the feedback!

[1] https://github.com/r-simmer/simmer/issues/171
